verdict.rationale: Phoenix exposes SDK-based dataset/experiment creation and evaluator scoring (docs-25/26/34/55, gh-1) plus an MCP server that lets agent clients like Claude Code or Cursor directly search, query, and operate on datasets, experiments, and evaluation results (docs-58). This covers programmatic dataset creation, eval triggering, and result read-back, though no end-to-end code sample is shown.
